items.titolo: Intel 14A defect density is dropping faster than the company expected — 'we have not seen this performance since 22nm,' says CFO
items.descrizione: Intel says defect density of 14A process technology is declining rapidly as internal teams are already developing 14A-based products, while external clients are now wondering about capacity that Intel can provide them.
